299)brul gtor skabs kyi dogs gcod dri lan gyi 'phros don 'ga' bzhugs so/brul gtor gyi skabs su/gtor snod kyi nang du ji ltar bshams pa'i dngo

tei:div.tei:p: 299) brul gtor skabs kyi dogs gcod dri lan gyi 'phros don 'ga' bzhugs so/ brul gtor gyi skabs su/ gtor snod kyi nang du ji ltar bshams pa'i dngos po bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam pa ni/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su mi bsgom par rang lus tha mal pa 'di nyid las slar rang lus 'di kho na 'dra ba gcig 'phros/ gnyis 'phros/ grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa zad med du 'phros nas gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po de'i nang du song bar bsam rgyu yin zhing*/ de yang brul gtor rim pa bzhi'i dang po de la/ gtor rdzas dang rang lus der song nas zhu zhing 'dres pa de thams cad dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs mchod pa'i rigs sna tshogs su gyur par dmigs te byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal/ gtsang rigs dkar mchog 300) la mnyes pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la 'bul bar dmigs/ ༈ gnyis pa de la/ gtor ma de yang thod pa stong gsum gyi khyon tsam du gyur pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas gang ba la/ rang gi lus 'di las 'di dang 'dra ba'i lus dpag tu med pa 'phros nas der song bas bdud rtsi de nyid sman rag gtor tshogs la sogs sogs gsang sngags nang gi mchod pa dpag med gyur par bsam nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la sogs sngags nang pa'i lha tshogs thamasacad la 'bul/ ༈ gsum pa de la gtor snod rin chen rgya khyon shin tu che ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa/ gtor rdzas kyang ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho yin pa la/ rnam pa gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa la sogs 'dod yon ma tshang ba med pa'i nang du/ bdag lus 'di las lus mang po 'phros nas thim pa 301)la brten nas slar yang 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam ste 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin/ ༈ bzhi pa de la/ gtor snod rgya khyon rab tu che ba'i nang du/

gtor rdzas rnams ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi la rnam pa bza' btung dang sha khrag glo rnying nang khrol dbang po lnga sogs gdon bgegs rnams so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i dngos por gyur pa'i nang du/ rang lus las 'di 'dra ba grangs med 'phros shing der thim pa dang*/ gdon bgegs lan chags 'byung po gnod byed rnams so so ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod du gyur nas bsngos pas/ lan chags bgegs rigs mtha' dag dge mgu zhing tshim ste gzhan la gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor zhi zhing byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'khod par bsam/ ༈ lnga pa la ni/ rang lus zhu ba de byed mi dgos par/ klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyi thugs dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas klu sman sogs ci rigs kyi longs spyod du 302) dmigs nas phul ba yin no/ mdor na shul gtor zhes ming du btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang lus mang po spros nas gtor ma'i nang du brul bar bsgom la brul gtor du ming btags pa yin par snang la/ 'di kho na rang gcig pu gtong na thog mar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang*/ mjug tu bsngo smon bkra shis gshegs gsol sogs dgos mod kyang*/ ding sang gtor ma gzhung dang po dang sbrel nas gtong ba yin tshe/ brgya rtsa tshar nas/ lhag gtor dang chos sbyin gyi rjes su ji ltar bsngos bzhin thog pa med par 'byung gyur cig ces pa'i skabs der skabs brul gtor bshams nas btang*/ de tshar ba dang yang*/ bar do cha bzhi'am/ 'byung bzhi sogs gang gtong bar mos pa rnams dal khom dang bstun nas btang ba'i rjes la/ gtor chas bsdu ba'i skabs su/ yo byad ma 'byor ting 'dzin g.yel 303) ba dang*/ zhes sogs kyi gshags pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya ba yin no/ yang gtor ma zhig gtong phyin chad brgya rtsa ma btang ba'i thabs med cing*/ brgya rtsa'i khogs su gzhan thams cad tshang zhing 'dus pa'i gnad kyis 'di gcig pus mi chog rgyu med pa dang*/

yang rgyas par byed spro na dkar cha bzhi/ 'dzam la/ brul gtor bar do/ 'byung bzhi la sogs rnams re mos byas nas btang bas yong ba dang*/ gzhan gang yang mi gtong na/ mchod pa'i mjug gi chu sbyin de ni nges par dgos tshe/ de dang brgya rtsa btang nas mjug gi las rim rnams byas pas 'thus pa yin pas de ltar thugs la bzhugs mdzod/ ces 'phral mar mtshams mal nas dge'o/ 304)
